quote.text: You do not need millions of followers to get rich with a personal brand. You just need a thousand of the right ones.

principles.text: Optimize for client lifetime value: a lower base retainer plus a performance fee, kept for longer, beats a high retainer that churns.
A client is only a client once they have paid, so collect payment on the call and never offer free trials.
Niche down to one niche and one service; added variation brings complexity, and complexity blocks scaling.
Build a personal brand for audience quality and value per follower, not follower count or views.
Start with a business you can fail at for a year without going broke, like services or digital products.

sampleQA.question: How should I price my agency retainers?

answer.text: Keep the base retainer low and make most of the pay performance-based, so your incentives match the client's.
Set the performance fee to kick in only above the client's existing baseline, and take a share of profit after ad spend, not a percentage of ad spend or revenue.
Use minimum terms (three to six months) and judge deals by guaranteed value; longer minimums can matter more than a higher monthly fee.
Price per client based on value and work involved instead of selling fixed packages.

sampleQA.question: How do I stop prospects saying "I need to think about it"?

answer.text: Pre-frame the call by agreeing upfront that you want a clear yes or no at the end.
Answer every question before pricing, then ask for a 1-10 score and probe anything under a 9 to surface hidden doubts.
Treat what remains as a trust objection: diffuse by agreeing first, reframe to their goal, tie down, isolate, then overcome.

sampleQA.question: Should I run paid ads to grow my coaching or info business?

answer.text: Not at first. Stay off paid ads until you pass about $10k a month organically, because the market and messaging aren't validated yet.
Organic customers trust you more, refund less and forgive hiccups compared with paid-traffic customers.
Ads can't fix a broken offer or build an audience from scratch; grow on one platform first.
